title: Construction of two-bubble solutions for the energy-critical Hartree equation
summary: We construct a pure two-bubble solution for the focusing, energy-critical Hartree equation in space dimension $N \geq 7$. The constructed solution is spherically symmetric, global in (at least) the negative time direction and asymptotically behaves as a superposition of two ground states (or bubbles) both centered at the origin, with the ratio of their length scales converging to $0$ and the phases of the two bubbles form the right angle.
